summary: Southern Company Gas and Southern Company Gas Capital Corporation filed an 8-K to report the execution of an underwriting agreement for a $500 million offering of Series 2026A 6.05% Fixed-to-Fixed Reset Rate Junior Subordinated Notes due 2056, issued under an existing shelf registration statement. The notes are guaranteed by Southern Company Gas. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The filing discloses the underwriting agreement, indenture, and legal opinions. No special-situation event such as a merger, acquisition, restructuring, or activist campaign is involved. The registrant is the issuer of the securities.
